items.desc: Treasurer Rabindra Joshi and accounts officer Sanjiv Pandey have been arrested as investigators examine home-and-away qualifiers played entirely in Bahrain, kit purchases and World Cup ticket sales.

items.title: What you should know about the article – and the platform – arguing Washington “groomed” Nepal’s new rulers

items.title: Swarnim Wagle calls for a reset in Nepal-India ties, says era of anti-India nationalism is over
items.desc: In an interview with The Hindu, the finance minister says Kathmandu wants to focus on trade, connectivity, energy, and reconstruction while constructively addressing contentious issues such as the boundary dispute.

items.title: Money is cheap in Nepal. Businesses still aren’t investing
items.desc: Banks are flush with lendable funds and interest rates are low, yet businesses remain reluctant to borrow and invest, reflecting weak confidence in the economy.

items.title: AfD leads as Merz rues ‘disaster’ in worst state election result in postwar Germany
items.desc: The AfD’s strong showing in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and gains in Berlin deepen pressure on Merz as his coalition faces voter anger over economic reforms and rising living costs.

items.title: Nepal wants high-paying careers. Its humanities classrooms are paying the price
items.desc: Student numbers in subjects like Sociology, Psychology and Mass Communication have fallen sharply as science and management gain ground.

items.title: Address trade disruption ahead of major festivals

items.title: Children in Madhesh are falling victim to abduction, sexual violence and killings
